response.summary: This tender invites bids for the fabrication and installation of target and pivot poles at Central Water Commission headquarters sites in Chennai under the PPSD project. The estimated cost is Rs. 1,21,268 with a completion period of 30 days.
key_requirements: Minimum 3 years experience in civil works, unless exempted as an MSE
Proof of similar works completed in the last 3 financial years (1 work >= 80% value, 2 works >= 60% value, or 3 works >= 40% value)
Submission of GST and PAN numbers, or an undertaking if turnover is below GST threshold
Tender validity for 60 days from the bid opening date
Submission of both Technical and Financial bids by 20.11.2026 @ 15.00 hrs
key_risks: Strict eligibility criteria regarding similar work value thresholds may disqualify smaller firms without MSE status
Short 30-day completion timeline requires immediate mobilization and resource availability
Prohibition on canvassing and strict conflict of interest rules regarding relatives in CWC/Ministry of Jal Shakti
